This is a DETERMINISTIC event, not stochastic. The pitch rate measurement artifact is reproducible and occurs at the same simulation step every time.

task_7_root_cause_classification.detailed_explanation: At step 1236, pitch rate measurement flips sign from +0.0572 to -0.0503 rad/s while pitch angle is still increasing (5.556° → 5.576°). This is physically inconsistent and represents a measurement artifact (likely gyro noise spike or numerical differentiation error). The sagittal velocity-damped controller uses pitch_rate directly without filtering or consistency checking. When pitch_rate flips sign, the pitch rate damping term (k_pitch_rate * pitch_rate) flips from +0.5724 Nm (opposing forward pitch rate) to -0.5030 Nm (amplifying backward pitch rate). This sudden removal of damping and addition of acceleration causes wheel acceleration to spike from -3.4 to -106.14 rad/s² at step 1237, initiating the transient cascade.

why_not_other_classifications.A_height_support_transient: COM height drops AFTER pitch rate flip (step 1324), not before. Height/support system is not the trigger.
why_not_other_classifications.C_torque_rate_limit_delay: The issue is the damping term itself flipping sign, not rate limiting delaying correction.

why_not_other_classifications.E_wheel_velocity_damping_insufficient: Wheel velocity damping cannot fix a pitch rate measurement artifact that removes pitch damping.
why_not_other_classifications.F_contact_transient: Contact is stable throughout (double_contact, no non-wheel contacts).
why_not_other_classifications.G_yaw_frame_projection_artifact: Support position error is real motion, tracks COM position error closely.
why_not_other_classifications.H_unknown_transient: Root cause is known and identified.

task_8_fix_recommendations.minimal_correct_fix: Add pitch rate consistency checking or filtering to prevent measurement artifacts from flipping the damping term sign

recommended_options.name: Pitch rate consistency check
recommended_options.description: Before using pitch_rate in the sagittal controller, verify it's consistent with the pitch angle finite-difference derivative. If inconsistent (opposite signs), use the finite-difference estimate instead.
recommended_options.rationale: Catches physically inconsistent measurements without adding lag. Finite-difference is noisy but sign-consistent.

recommended_options.name: Pitch rate low-pass filter
recommended_options.description: Add a low-pass filter (e.g., exponential moving average) to pitch_rate to smooth out measurement artifacts.
recommended_options.rationale: Smooths artifacts but adds phase lag, which can destabilize damping. Not recommended for real-time balance control.

recommended_options.name: Pitch rate deadband
recommended_options.description: Add a small deadband around zero pitch_rate (e.g., ±0.01 rad/s) to prevent sign flips during near-zero rates.
recommended_options.rationale: Prevents sign flips near zero but doesn't fix the underlying measurement artifact. May mask the problem without solving it.

task_8_fix_recommendations.recommended_fix: Option 1: Pitch rate consistency check. This is the minimal correct fix that addresses the root cause without adding lag or masking the problem.

conclusion.root_cause: Pitch rate measurement artifact at step 1236 causes damping sign flip, triggering wheel acceleration spike and subsequent transient.
conclusion.fix_scope: Add pitch rate consistency checking in SagittalVelocityDampedBalanceController before using pitch_rate in damping term.
conclusion.fix_complexity: Low — single function modification, no architectural changes.
